correctness.rationale: Reconstructed depth-one modal algebra: the truth values of color tests chi_j and diamonds Diamond chi_j separate precisely the signature (c(v), neighbor color support), and Boolean combinations define every singleton exactly when these are all distinct. Below threshold expected absent color-vertex pairs divided by n is q(1-p/q)^(n-1)=o(1), so almost every vertex is color-saturated and q=o(n) forces collision. Above threshold, conditioned on a matching own-color pair, each other color j yields independent mismatch contributions 2a_j(1-a_j), a_j=(1-p)^M_j. Poisson occupancy expectation mu=(q-1)(e^-p lambda-e^-p(2-p)lambda)=n^(1-p/alpha+o(1))/log n tends polynomially to infinity; Chernoff and de-Poissonization factor O(sqrt(n)) give pair collision o(n^-2), then union bound. Boundary alpha=p explicitly unproved. Independently exhaustive small-graph logical comparison (1,098 configurations) was consistent but is not an asymptotic proof.
